name: neuCentrIX Pugeran Yogyakarta
notes: Telkom launched neuCentrIX Pugeran on 2024-10-10 as its 25th completed data center and second Yogyakarta location after Kotabaru; capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Kota Baru Yogyakarta
notes: DCD reports Pugeran is Telkom's second Yogyakarta data center after an earlier Kotabaru site; DataCenterMap lists neuCentrIX Kota Baru at Jl. Yos Sudarso No. 9.

name: Microsoft Indonesia Central cloud region / Karawang data centers
notes: Microsoft announced opening of its first Indonesia cloud region, Indonesia Central, with in-country data residency; DataCenterMap identifies multiple Microsoft Jakarta facilities in Karawang/GIIC, West Java. Individual facility capacities not disclosed by Microsoft.

name: Microsoft JKT09 Karawang data center
notes: CNA reported Microsoft is building a 48 MW data centre at Karawang International Industrial City, with more facilities planned at the site; W.Media reported JK09 in Karawang remains under construction.

name: DCI H1 Campus JK6, Cibitung
notes: DCI says JK6 launched on 2025-06-03 at the H1 Campus in Cibitung, West Java, with 36 MW capacity and service to a major global cloud provider.

name: DCI H2 Data Center Campus, Karawang
notes: DCI and Salim Group inaugurated H2-02 at the Karawang H2 campus; H2-01 had operated since Nov 2021, bringing two data centers to 27 MW IT load, with campus potential up to 600 MW.

name: STT Jakarta 2, GIIC Cikarang
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres / Triputra / Temasek
notes: STT Jakarta 2 factsheet places the facility at GIIC, Cikarang, Bekasi, West Java with 24 MW IT load; ready-for-service target Q1 2026.

name: STT Jakarta 6, GIIC Cikarang
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres / Triputra / Temasek
notes: STT Jakarta 6 factsheet places the 40 MW IT load facility at GIIC, Cikarang, Bekasi, West Java; RFS target Q4 2027 and part of a campus planned above 360 MW.

name: Princeton Digital Group JC3 Greater Jakarta Campus
notes: PDG announced groundbreaking for the USD 1 billion, 120 MW JC3 campus in Greater Jakarta; PDG location materials describe JC3 as a planned two-building campus.

name: Princeton Digital Group JC4 Greater Jakarta Campus
notes: PDG announced acquisition of a new Greater Jakarta site with land secured and power allocated for 240 MW planned capacity; exact municipality not disclosed, likely West Java/Bekasi metro cluster.

name: Digital Edge CGK Campus, GIIC Bekasi
notes: Digital Edge announced a USD 4.5B AI-ready campus at GIIC Industrial Estate in Bekasi, delivering 500 MW IT capacity at full buildout with scalability up to 1 GW; DCD reported the first building CGK1 topped out in May 2026.

name: AWS CGK Kutanegara
notes: Registry listings identify an AWS CGK facility at Jalan Surya Utama, Kutanegara, Karawang, West Java; Baxtel lists year built 2021. AWS does not publicly disclose capacity.

name: neuCentrIX Pontianak
notes: Telkom inaugurated neuCentrIX Pontianak on Jl. Teuku Umar with 57 racks, connected to other Kalimantan neuCentrIX sites and TelkomGroup data centers; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Mitrakom Data Center Mataram
notes: DataCenterMap and KF Map list Mitrakom Data Center Mataram at Jl. Taruna Jaya No. 2, Taman Sari/Ampenan, Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara; capacity and completion year not supplied.

name: Mitrakom Data Center Manokwari
notes: DataCenterMap lists Mitrakom Data Center Manokwari at Jl. Arfai, Kel. Andai, Distrik Manokwari. Capacity and completion year not supplied.

name: Padang data center listing
notes: DataCenterMap reports one listed data center in Padang, Indonesia, but public search snippets did not expose the operator/name and independent confirmation was not found during this batch run.
